# AI Usage Statement Options

Choose one and edit it to match the real process. Do not use a statement that hides AI involvement.

## Option A - Short and Safe

AI assistants were used during this project to support documentation drafting, report organisation, diagram descriptions, and parts of code generation and review. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, tested, and edited by the team before submission.

## Option B - More Detailed

During this project, AI assistants were used mainly to help organise the project documents, draft report sections, prepare UML/ER diagram descriptions, write test case descriptions, and support parts of Java/JDBC code generation and review. The team manually reviewed the generated materials, ran tests, adjusted the implementation, and prepared to explain the database design and code during the interview.

## Option C - Report Appendix Style

The group used AI assistance as a supporting tool. AI was helpful for creating first drafts of documentation, suggesting report structure, preparing example wording for the video script, and checking some implementation ideas. AI also supported parts of code generation and review. The final submitted work was checked by the group, and the group members are responsible for understanding and explaining the system.

## Option D - Very Explicit

AI tools were used in both documentation and development support. For documentation, AI helped draft the requirements document, database design explanations, interface/API document, test document, report outline, video script, and member preparation notes. For implementation, AI helped generate and review parts of the HTML/CSS/JavaScript front-end, Java HTTP server, JDBC, service, DAO, SQL, and test code. The team reviewed, tested, and edited these materials before submission.

## What Not To Write

Do not write:

> AI was only used for writing documents and all code was written completely by ourselves.

That statement is not suitable if AI helped with code in any way.

## Suggested Final Version For This Project

AI assistants were used during this project mainly to help draft documentation, organise report content, prepare diagram descriptions, and support parts of code generation and review. All AI-assisted materials were checked and edited by the team. The team ran automated tests and manually reviewed the main workflows, and each member prepared to explain their assigned module, the database design, and the system behaviour during the interview.
